## Cross-review

- Attack Pattern fingerprints were compared at CR 5 and CR 15 after stripping migration and parity metadata.
- Shared base actions are permitted; entire parent patterns may not compile to the same mechanical bundle.
- Declared complexity may not be lower than the highest authored decision, branch, sequence, or tracking score.
- Duplicate climbing chassis and infrastructure-heavy web features must produce a soft compatibility conflict.

## Monster Manual style review

Calibration: 503 MM'25 monsters and 2608 authored entries from `Bestiary.csv`.

| Metric | Cruor CR 5 catalog |
|---|---:|
| Authored abilities | 125 |
| Median words | 42 |
| Mean words | 43.45 |
| 75th percentile | 57 |
| 90th percentile | 68 |
| Maximum | 90 |
| Hard limit | 90 |

Cruor abilities remain intentionally more procedural than the MM'25 median, but no ability may exceed the hard limit. Text above 75 words requires an explicit rationale.

### Reviewed long-form abilities

| Graft | Ability | Words | Rationale |
|---|---|---:|---|
| `dangerously-unstable` | Dangerously Unstable | 80 | The visible countdown, blast, self-destruction, and player disarm procedure form one indivisible encounter event. |
| `choking-air` | Choking Air | 77 | The lair action must state the breathing exception, vertical answer, and ventilation break condition explicitly. |
| `broodmother-web-lair` | Broodmother Web | 76 | The maintained prison must include the save, escape action, object statistics, exclusivity, and lair-action commitment. |
| `mask-phase` | Changing Mask | 90 | Three mutually exclusive modes plus the fire suppression and removal procedure must remain in one trait. |

## Playability review

- 372 graft/CR projections compiled across CR 1, 5, 10, and 15.
- Every graft retains telegraph, positioning, break-condition, and non-damage counterplay channels.
- Table-facing families retain executable default procedures.
- Infrastructure-heavy web features and duplicate climbing chassis surface soft compatibility warnings instead of silently stacking tracking load.
